title: "Cheat sheets"
subtitle: "Every chapter's key equations on one page"
jupyter: python3
execute:
  echo: false
  freeze: false     # rebuilt on every render, so it never lags the chapter pages
---

Each chapter page ends with a cheat sheet of its key equations. This page collects them all, in book order. A ★ marks equations well known by name. Each "eq." link opens the full explanation on the chapter page: the equation in words, term by term, and why it holds.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path

from adm.page import cheat_sheet, page_title

PARTS = [("Introduction", "intro"), ("Part I — Probabilistic Reasoning", "part1"),
         ("Part II — Sequential Problems", "part2"), ("Part III — Model Uncertainty", "part3"),
         ("Part IV — State Uncertainty", "part4"), ("Part V — Multiagent Systems", "part5")]
for heading, folder in PARTS:
    print(f"\n## {heading}\n")
    for page in sorted(Path(folder).glob("ch*.qmd")):
        href = f"{folder}/{page.name}"
        print(f"\n### [{page_title(page)}]({href})\n")
        print(cheat_sheet(page, href))
        print()
```
